scope: Read-only bulk screening, not an applied heat flux. Same inherited momentum collision law. Te gradient scale uses resolved saved fields.
closure: At zero electron particle flux, drift-diffusion energy flux reduces to q_e=-(5/2)*n_e*kB*D_e*grad(Te); D_e=kB*Te/(m_e*nu). Local classical closure requires a small mean-free-path/gradient-length ratio.
